sentences.text: Arup US’s reports score lower than Mortenson’s and JE Dunn Construction’s and can’t be told apart from WSP’s.
Across all their report types, Arup US’s reports score a typical 1.7 points lower than Mortenson’s (95% interval 1.4 to 1.9; 351 and 135 reports).
Comparing like with like, the gap narrows to 0.1 points (−0.3 to 0.7) and can’t be told apart from chance.
For every 100 claims, Arup US’s reports have 7.9 that claim more cause than the study shows and Mortenson’s have 5.5 (Arup US’s 1.4 times as many; 1.2 to 1.8).
Against WSP, the gap can’t be told apart from chance with this many reports.
Arup US’s reports score a typical 0.9 points lower than JE Dunn Construction’s (0.6 to 1.1; 351 and 111 reports).
Since 2016, Mortenson’s scores have fallen by about 0.5 points a year (0.2 to 0.6).
Arup US’s and Mortenson’s trends in scores differ by about 0.5 points a year (0.3 to 0.7).
